topic: SP-060 security lows: chat in public spaces
detail: From the PR security review. (1) Low: a chat tenant bound to a public space is quarantined at placement, but the policy still accepts the binding; consider refusing it at apply time. (2) Low: an operator retag of a chat source into a public space is honoured (honorsRetag treats chat like the syncs), so that thread would be read by every space; refuse retags of chat sources into public spaces. (3) Low, pre-existing D-71: with no spaces policy a process an agent detached from its session passes as the operator, so it can call SearchDirectMessages; with no policy there is no isolation either.
